item.title: Brunswick County Sheriff’s Office charges Supply man with attempted first-degree murder following a shooting incident
item.description: The Brunswick County Sheriff’s Office have charged Trevor Joe Freeman, 24, of Civietown Road in Supply, with attempted first-degree murder following a shooting incident that occurred on December 29, 2025, at 9:15 p.m.

item.title: Novant Health implemented new visitation restrictions amid rising flu cases
item.description: NEW HANOVER COUNTY (WWAY) — In the Cape Fear, several hospitals have new visitation restrictions to help prevent the spread of the flu. Novant Health has added visitation restrictions now that the flu has ramped up nationwide. The number of cases is climbing, and this virus can be very harmful, and at times fatal. item.title: From Pope Francis to Charlie Kirk, many deaths in 2025 had a wide impact
item.description: The death of Pope Francis brought change to the Catholic Church, which counts 1.4 billion adherents and is now led — for the first time — by an American pope. The fatal shooting of conservative activist Charlie Kirk as he spoke before a crowd horrified many and prompted somber conversations about political violence.

item.title: Where are the wackiest New Year’s Eve drops in the US?
item.description: Why let New York City have all the fun with its Times Square ball drop on New Year’s Eve? Dozens of places across the U.S. will ring in 2026 by dropping a quirky assortment of fruits, vegetables, sea creatures and balls of all shapes and sizes. Many have a hometown flair.
